title: URGENT: Finder-local mkdir → 내 드라이브/Audiso Music
instruction: CEO: Finder folder = Drive auto-sync. NO Drive API/OAuth. Prefer: bash scripts/mac-bootstrap-from-git.sh AUD-MUS-20260825-004 (pull main, sync GLOBAL→ROOT, then mkdir). Or: bash scripts/mac-create-audiso-music-mydrive.sh AUD-MUS-20260825-004. Creates ~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-okas2000@gmail.com/My Drive (or 내 드라이브)/Audiso Music/<track>. Requires Drive desktop = okas2000@gmail.com ONLY (not yonsei).
ceo_action: Mac: Drive desktop = okas2000@gmail.com mounted. Phone: Drive app → 내 드라이브 → Audiso Music
